result:
I planned round 471: **STORE-2c-1, the Store font family swap to Instrument Sans and IBM Plex Mono**. The decision is **CONTINUE**. The Store source is untouched (0 changed files), and the round-470 task is archived as `tasks/round-470.md`.

**Round 470:** C passed it with real browser checks, and root published it as `5cd9645`.
- C-R469-01 (the glow shape bug) is closed.
- The Store scroll fix (SABA-B-15) works in the cloud but is not marked done. It stays open until Saba checks scrolling on his own device (deadline RETRO 480).
- C asked how to read "cluster" in the scroll test. My ruling: one slow frame at the same spot that also shows on HEAD and on a build with no glows is not a cluster. C's pass stands, and that frame is filed as a deferred Low (C-R470-F1).
- I recorded the gate reviewer's and A's reviewer's notes as architecture signals, not tasks.

**Round 471 (STORE-2c-1):**
- **Why now:** STORE-2c no longer needs root. The fonts are already self-hosted and loaded on every page, so only the theme lines in `app/styles/app.css` and the body font rule change.
- **The split:** STORE-2c is now four stages, with nothing dropped: font families (2c-1), heading weight and body text sizes (2c-2), Plex Mono labels (2c-3), and deleting the old Inter and Playfair files (2c-4).
- **Font weights:** Instrument Sans only comes in weights 400–600, so today's bold headings will render at 600 for now. product-designer agreed the font swap can go live on its own, with the mono font included.
- **Timing of 2c-2:** it has to come right after the regression round and its fix-ups, with no other feature stage in between.
- **Test change:** the current font test (FN4) fails on any font swap, so the task grants a rewrite of it plus a new check (FN6). Both fail when run against the old `app.css`.
- **My measurements** (builds of HEAD and my sketch, 8 pages at 1440, 1280 and 375 px):
  - no horizontal overflow and no clipped text;
  - Inter and Playfair are no longer downloaded;
  - layout shift stays below 0.03 on every page;
  - Georgian text renders in Noto Sans Georgian;
  - a long product title wraps the same as on HEAD.
- **Wrap changes:** most paragraphs get shorter. Exactly three text lines grow at 375 px: the `/about` heading (2→3 lines), "The Complete Collection" on the home page (1→2) and the "Sounds Delivered" label on `/about` (1→2). The task accepts those three; any other growth is a fail for C.

**Question for Saba:** the old purchased Studio page (`/studio/<handle>`) will pick up the new fonts too, without any protected file being edited. product-designer and I accept that by default. Saba is asked once in `user-review/questions-round-470.md` Q1 and can say no.

**Next:** the first planning on or after 2026-11-13 is the REGRESSION-2026-11-13 round, then STORE-2c-2…4, 2d and STORE-3…5. Root has two non-blocking requests:
- the summary file (`context/active-backlog.json`) wrongly shows STORE-REDESIGN as done;
- the first design-philosophy review, together with Saba's old-logo-colours report (SABA-B-16).

The advisor was available. I consulted it twice, once before planning and once before handing off. The second pass led me to widen the measurements and correct several of C's checks.

Files are in `tmp/studio-real-loop/`:
- current-task.md
- b-round-470.md
- b-next.json
- feature-status.md
- backlog.json
- b-round-470/
